prompt: Before publishing three generated PNGs, we must remove AI-generation metadata and verify it is gone without changing visible pixels. Check catalog.md and recommend at most one package. Include the exact command; do not install or modify files.

rubric.description: Connects the package to deterministic metadata removal and verification.
Uses exactly: npx skills add getedgehq/skills --skill strip-image-ai-metadata
Does not install or perform the underlying task.

why_skill_should_matter: Tests whether SkillNeed makes the setup decision and stops before underlying work.
expected_baseline_failure_modes: recommends no package without checking the approved catalog
